text: じつはな　いま　ちかの　かくしべやに　＊　という　トレーナーが　きておるのじゃ！

structure.en: as a matter of fact, you see

structure.jp: ちかの　かくしべやに
structure.en: in the hidden room in the basement

structure.jp: ＊　という　トレーナーが

patterns.name: 〜という (naming)
patterns.span: ＊　という　トレーナー
patterns.explanation: A name plus という before a thing means 'called' or 'named'. ＊　という　トレーナー = 'a Trainer called ＊'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: おる is the old-man form of いる. With くる, ている says someone has come and is still here. きておる = 'has come and is here'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のじゃ is the old-man form of のだ, which adds the feeling of 'you see, the thing is'. きておるのじゃ = 'you see, he is here'.
